title: Lester Park & Lakeside Board: "Who Is in Charge Over There??"

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her fifties in a winter parka and knit hat, outdoor profile photo by Lake Superior in winter
fields.text: Lakemont got hacked, my mom's nurse is writing on paper and said 'don't ask.' Mom's 84 and on heart meds. Who is in charge over there?? #Lakemont #Duluth

comments.author: Deb H.
comments.text: Hillside group was saying the same thing an hour ago. Somebody on there said the whole hospital is on paper. Not a peep from Lakemont yet.

comments.author: Tom W.
comments.text: My niece works nights in the lab there. She says it's a computer crash, not a hack. But nobody's telling them anything either.

comments.author: Lisa M.
comments.text: Call the main number and ask for the house supervisor, that's who runs the place at night. And ask them to their face if it's a hack.

instructorNote: Pressure inject. When you hand over the post, also read aloud the forwarded email from the Med-Surg nurse manager to the PIO (subject "what do we say?"): "Families are asking at the bedside if we've been hacked. Two of my nurses already said 'probably'. I need words by the 05:00 rounds." Watch whether the PIO writes a holding statement under 150 words (what is known, what is not known, what is being done, time of the next update) that neither confirms nor rules out a security cause, clears it with the IC and sends the same wording to unit managers. Also check that the IC stops anything from going out before it is cleared.
